messages:
maria: quick sync — i'm proposing a 3-week sprint to lock down v1->v2 route compatibility work. scope: migration guides, short-lived shim headers, sdk patches, canary rollout plan, docs + support playbook. looking for scope pushback.
ben: +1. need to prioritize function/tool-calling compatibility first — customers keep hitting that.
sam: agree on tool-calling. also call out structured-output changes; it's breaking for a few analytics customers.
anita: FYI: embeddings route also has subtle contract differences (metadata field name). would like a small automated test suite in the migration guide to validate.
maria: good — proposed acceptance criteria: 1) migration guide with examples for each surface (chat/completions, embeddings, rerank, tool-calls, structured output). 2) SDK patch for node/python that maps old response shapes. 3) router-level shim: accept header X-API-Compat: v1 to route to legacy behavior for 8 weeks post-cutover. 4) canary traffic + automatic rollback on error rate > 3x baseline.
leo: can we tighten canary to 5% traffic for 48h with tracing hooks? ops-bot: deploy policy template exists: /policies/canary/safe-rollout-v1.yaml
ben: migration guide should include code snippets for common failure modes and a small linter rule (open-source), so customers can run against prompts.
anita: + add regression tests that run on commit for both v1 and v2 schemas. tests should be runnable locally.
maria: timeline suggestion: week 1 spec + docs + sdk PRs, week 2 shim + tests + staging canary, week 3 customer pilot + cutover automation + support playbook.
docs: send me the list of example requests/responses per surface and i'll draft the migration page. prefer YAML examples and curl snippets.
jack: how are we communicating the deprecation timeline? customers want concrete dates. recommend: announce now (soft), 2 weeks later public docs + migration tool, 8 weeks after announce start of gradual cutover, 16 weeks full deprecation.
sam: that seems long but gives enterprise teams runway. we should offer Dedicated customers extended exemptions via support tickets.
maria: agreed. also proposal: include a feature-flagged 'compat:strict' mode that errors early in staging for teams proactively testing.
ben: risk log: 1) tool-calls with plugin auth differences, 2) structured-output schema mismatches, 3) embeddings metadata rename -> search regressions. we should map owners for each.
maria: owners: tool-calls=ben, structured-output=anita, embeddings=leo. add runbook entries.
ops-bot: incident template created: /incidents/compat-cutover-template.md
anita: one more ask: include a small SDK shim that transforms v1 response.label -> v2.label_name for a transitional period. i can prototype.
maria: great. next actions: - ben draft canary policy + rollback metrics - docs create migration snippets - anita prototype sdk shim - ops prepare cutover runbook and support triage playbook. checkin tomorrow 10am PT. :thumbsup:
